object.name: RichBlockThinking
object.description: A block with a 'Thinking…' placeholder, corresponding to the custom HTML tag <tg-thinking>. The block may be used only in sendRichMessageDraft, therefore it can't be received in messages. See https://t.me/addemoji/AIActions for examples of custom emoji that are recommended for usage in the block.
